title: Diagnose the recurring backup Copy-phase deadline overrun
outcome: Diagnose the recurring backup Copy-phase deadline overrun
acceptance: The test-only Copy recorder retains bounded busy-callback aggregates without per-callback log allocation, distinguishes admission failure from connection close and cleanup, and preserves the original SQLite primary and extended error codes; deterministic tests verify the recorder's bounds, thread isolation and event order.

Expiry immediately after opening the source or before admission/copy produces the existing typed Copy-phase deadline refusal, starts no later copy work, closes its connection and releases its wait scope, and removes only the attempt's stage; deterministic boundary tests verify these outcomes.

backup::tests::capture_deadline_bounds_a_wait_for_a_locked_store passes with its existing 1500 ms capture deadline and unchanged less-than-five-second assertion; the changes make no claim that the original 7.636-second stall has been attributed or corrected.

completion.summary: Landed bounded test-only Copy diagnostics and deterministic expiry-boundary refusal/resource-cleanup coverage. Original 1500 ms / <5 s locked-store test passed unchanged; original 7.636-second cause remains separate and unattributed. Full exact-input gate passed 12/12, Codex+Claude whole-input review had no Medium+, two deferred Lows filed independently, fresh independent closure evaluation passed 3/3. One clean release built, all six stores ready before and after installation, fast-forward push verified; archived 384 byte-verified evidence files and mapped known citers.
